videos.script: Nearly every question about data ends the same way. This number, per that. {{per}} Trips per station. Minutes per plan. Rain per month. {{examples}} pandas answers all of them with one method, groupby. {{groupby}} It splits the table by the values of a column. It applies a calculation to each piece. And it combines the answers into one result. {{sac}} This lesson builds summary tables with names a reader understands. {{agg}} It gives every trip its own station's typical length, so a long trip is long for where it started. {{transform}} And it counts the trips groupby left out without a word. A hundred and forty-six bikes that never came back belong to no group. {{dropped}} After every groupby, check that the groups add up to the table. {{end}}
